Returns its lines, numbered, and its version.<|"|>,parameters:{properties:{limit:{description:<|"|>At most this many lines.<|"|>,type:<|"|>INTEGER<|"|>},path:{description:<|"|>Path of the file, relative to the workspace root.<|"|>,type:<|"|>STRING<|"|>}},required:[<|"|>path<|"|>],type:<|"|>OBJECT<|"|>}}<tool|><|tool>declaration:write{description:<|"|>Create a file, or replace one whole.
